title: prunecss configuration
description: Settings for a prunecss run. Paths are relative to the config file.

$schema.description: Location of this schema, for editor autocompletion.

content.description:
Files whose class names count as used: files, directories or globs
such as `src/**/*.{html,jsx,tsx,vue,svelte,astro}`.

css.description:
Stylesheets to prune: files, directories or globs such as
`dist/**/*.css`.

fontFace.description: Also remove `@font-face` rules whose family nothing uses.

gitignore.description:
Skip files listed in `.gitignore` and `.ignore` when expanding globs.
Files named directly are always used. Defaults to `true`.

output.description:
Where to write the result: a file when pruning one stylesheet, a
directory when pruning several. Omit to print a single stylesheet to
standard output. Ignored when stylesheets are given on the command
line: then only `--output` decides.

safelist.description:
Names to keep whatever the content says. Each entry is an exact name
or a `/regex/`. A plain list means `standard`.

variables.description: Also remove custom properties (`--name`) that nothing reads.

deep.description: Keep matching selectors and every rule nested inside them.

greedy.description: Keep any selector containing a matching class or id.

standard.description: A matching class or id counts as used.

variables.description: Never remove matching custom properties (written without `--`).

SafelistConfig.description: The `safelist` setting: a plain list, or patterns by kind.

anyOf.description: Patterns by kind, as in PurgeCSS.
